name: ping-a-human
description: Codex plugin that lets coding agents send a short local macOS ping when human input is required.

interface.shortDescription: Notify a human when an agent is blocked.
interface.longDescription: Packages a Codex skill with a macOS Swift/AppKit toast helper and AppleScript fallback so coding agents can send one short local desktop ping when work is blocked on human input.
defaultPrompt: Use $ping-a-human when you need me to return.
Ping me if you are blocked on approval.
Notify me when browser login is needed.
